metadata.gitb:name: [dpp.core] Validate an uploaded Digital Product Passport
metadata.gitb:description: Upload a passport as JSON-LD and validate it against the "dpp.core" shapes (OpenEPCIS DPP Core — ESPR 2024/1781 (cross-cutting)). The passport's own @context is resolved from ref.openepcis.org, so it must reference the published contexts — the same condition a real consumer of the passport faces.

verify.desc: Validate against the dpp.core SHACL shapes

failure.default: "The passport does not conform to dpp.core. The failed step's report lists every violation."
